subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw approve openai/codex-action@52fe01ec70a42f454c9d2ebd47598f9fd6893d56 for workflows that pass an OpenAI API key, or keep that update out of this grouped Dependabot PR?
rationale: The required decision is about whether the new third-party action revision remains acceptable in a credential-bearing workflow; that security boundary cannot be resolved from Dependabot metadata alone.

options.title: Split and review the Codex action separately
options.body: Merge the independently reviewable action updates only after removing the Codex action bump, then review that credential-bearing upgrade with source and live workflow evidence.

options.title: Explicitly approve the grouped update
options.body: A workflow/security owner may accept the new Codex action revision after directly reviewing its source contract and the final-head credentialed workflow result.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Leave the PR open until both the action contract and redacted runtime evidence are available.

recommendation.title: Split and review the Codex action separately
recommendation.body: Merge the independently reviewable action updates only after removing the Codex action bump, then review that credential-bearing upgrade with source and live workflow evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely repository-level owner for the security-sensitive workflow decision; the available history evidence does not identify a narrower owner.
